title: Vault: recover-ha (boot-race recovery - transit unseal then restart raft)
description: Runs `nexus recover-ha vault --yes`: the boot-race recovery sequence - unseal vault-transit from the Shamir key file, restart vault-1/2/3, then poll until each reports unsealed. Idempotent: a no-op when the cluster is already up.

observe.what: vault-transit unsealed from the Shamir key file, then vault-1/2/3 restarted and polled; all nodes sealed=no, transit=unsealed; idempotent no-op when already up

whatProves: VaultAdapter.RecoverHaAsync replays the documented boot-race recovery - unseal vault-transit from the Shamir key file, restart the three raft nodes, and poll until unsealed - and is idempotent (no-op when the cluster is already healthy).
